decision: Test whether TaskGate improves agent answer quality at a common exposure risk, independently from whether experts can understand and configure its budget units.

agent_utility.causal_question: At budgets frozen before any agent run, how do policies affect task quality, completion, and exposure?
agent_utility.inputs: component-wise lower medians from the calibration panel, frozen with a SHA-256 artifact
agent_utility.independence: approval-usability decisions never suppress, relabel, or zero-score an agent run

expert_budget_usability.causal_question: Can independent practitioners understand, set, approve, reject, or narrow each budget representation?
expert_budget_usability.inputs: task objective, catalog, sensitivity labels, risk preference, and unit cards only
expert_budget_usability.hidden: agent queries, agent outputs, hidden truth, other experts' choices, and experiment-A outcomes
expert_budget_usability.separate_outcome: approve/reject/narrow is analyzed only as expert usability and is not an execution gate in experiment A

arms.enforcement: release, influence, and outcome fact ceilings at the shared root task
successful query-response count ceiling, including zero-row and negative answers; V3 facts computed audit-only
cumulative visible-row ceiling; V3 facts computed audit-only
cumulative canonical-response bytes buffered before release; V3 facts computed audit-only
no study exposure ceiling; ordinary safety, scope, timeout, and authorization controls remain active

sampling.seed_semantics: 0--4 are paired replicate labels supplied in the task context; the DeepSeek API exposes no deterministic sampling-seed parameter
sampling.assignment: within-task paired primary arms; five-arm order uses a task-randomized cyclic Latin square; every run receives a fresh database, root task, cache namespace, and conversation

task_provenance.promotion_requirement: at least one non-author domain practitioner must author or substantively adapt each task, and a second must independently accept it before collection
task_provenance.prohibited_claim: representative synthetic cases may not be described as historical production tickets

budget_calibration.training: unit cards, organization risk-preference card, and two excluded training tasks
budget_calibration.aggregation: per-task and per-arm component-wise lower median of independent integer ceilings
budget_calibration.agreement: report per-item relative MAD and per-domain/arm/unit Kendall's W
budget_calibration.freeze: canonical JSON binds task manifest, protocol, source expert records, aggregated ceilings, model card, prompt digest, and tool-surface digest
budget_calibration.unlimited: not shown to budget experts and receives no budget ceiling

expert_budget_usability.panel: nine non-author practitioners, three per domain, disjoint from calibration and blind grading
expert_budget_usability.narrowing: approved ceilings and scopes may only become stricter
expert_budget_usability.agent_independence: these decisions are never passed to the agent runner

agent_execution.failure_policy: retain budget exhaustion, tool errors, and agent errors as zero completion; do not silently drop runs

primary.definition: prelocked weighted rubric score for every primary-arm run at the frozen median expert budget

analysis.unit: task-agent-seed run; queries are diagnostics, not independent samples
analysis.primary_inference: within-task-and-seed paired TaskGate-minus-baseline rubric-score differences with task-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals and exact task-level sign-flip tests

secondary_mixed_models.completion: completed ~ policy + domain + difficulty + (1|task) + (1|seed), binomial link

analysis.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction for the three TaskGate-versus-baseline primary contrasts
analysis.utility_risk: construct per-policy Pareto frontiers from the registered 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, and 1.25 budget multipliers; bootstrap tasks, not queries
analysis.unlimited: report as a task-quality upper-bound diagnostic, never as a primary budget competitor

guardrails: No paper claim may call this an expert-calibrated agent workflow study while status is designed_not_collected.
Templates and synthetic records are not expert judgments or agent outcomes.
Experiment-B approval outcomes do not gate experiment-A runs.
The same frozen model, prompt, tool surface, database snapshot, and seed schedule are used across arms.
Baseline arms are compared on post-hoc V3 risk, not on incomparable native budget units.
Human graders are blind to arm, budget, model trace identifiers, and paper hypothesis.
